name: Lennar
description: Lennar is one of the largest US homebuilders by deliveries (82,583 homes including unconsolidated entities in fiscal 2025, average price $391,000), selling mostly under the single Lennar brand. Homebuilding is 94 percent of $34.2B revenue; around it sit a financial-services arm (mortgage, title, closing, plus a commercial mortgage business, LMF Commercial) and a multifamily developer that builds apartments with partner capital and earns fees and equity income. It runs a land-light model: in February 2025 it spun off a large share of its land holdings into Millrose Properties and now buys lots from land banks and options. Margins have been squeezed by price cuts and incentives (average price down 8 percent in FY2025).

businessLines.name: Homebuilding
businessLines.how: Homebuyers pay a deposit at contract and the full price at delivery (one-time, average $391,000 in FY2025), mostly with a mortgage; profit is price less land, construction and selling cost, with Everything's Included bundling options into the price.
businessLines.description: Builds and sells single-family attached and detached homes in four reportable regions (East, Central, South Central, West) plus Other, for first-time, move-up, active-adult and luxury buyers.

revenue.note: Sales of homes $32,097.2M; land $130.2M; other $39.2M. By region: East $6,970.2M, Central $7,756.1M, South Central $5,604.4M, West $11,909.1M, Other $26.8M.

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $5,342.3M. Includes a one-time $156.1M loss on the Millrose exchange offer. By region FY2025 pre-tax: East $703.8M, Central $668.1M, South Central $493.1M, West $1,116.3M. Share is of segment earnings before corporate costs, $3,533.2M; shares and margin computed.

businessLines.name: Financial Services
businessLines.how: Gain on sale of mortgage loans originated to Lennar homebuyers, title and closing fees, and commercial loan origination and sale income.
businessLines.description: Residential mortgage origination, title insurance and closing services for Lennar buyers, plus LMF Commercial (small and mid-size commercial mortgages originated and sold).

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $577.2M. Six months to 2026-05-31 $157.3M vs $192.4M. Shares computed.

businessLines.name: Multifamily
businessLines.how: Development and management fees, plus equity earnings and gains when projects are sold or recapitalised; lumpy by project timing.
businessLines.description: Develops multifamily rental communities, mostly through joint ventures with outside investors, and sponsors and manages funds.

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 +$42.6M. Six months to 2026-05-31 -$14.8M vs +$36.2M. Lennar's net investment in Multifamily $781.9M at 2025-11-30.

businessLines.name: Lennar Other
businessLines.how: Mostly gains and losses on technology and other investments plus fund fees; not an operating business.
businessLines.description: Technology investments (LENX), single-family rental fund management and other.

operatingProfit.note: Includes $130.2M of gains from technology investments; FY2024 -$48.0M.
